transcript: Here is 40 years of a monk's wisdom in one minute. You become what you think, again and again. So be careful what you feed your mind. Emotions are not your enemies. They are quiet teachers. Fear shows you what matters. Anger shows you where you were hurt. Anxiety pulls you away from now. Come back. Do not wait for motivation. It is like the wind. It does not stay. Build small habits. They will carry you when motivation cannot. Your past is not who you are. It is only where you have been. When someone disturbs you, pause. Look within first. Control is an illusion, but your choices are always yours. In the end, it is simple. Your thoughts shape you. Your habits build you. Your choices define you. If this brought you back to yourself, comment still and follow.
